title: Renew a recreational fishing licence
summary: Learn how to renew your recreational fishing licence for NSW waters online or by phone.
intro:
When fishing in NSW waters, both freshwater and saltwater, you're legally required to pay a recreational fishing fee and carry the receipt showing payment.

You can renew your 1-year or 3-year recreational fishing licence online or by phone.

Note: If you renew before your expiry date, your renewal begins from the date your current licence expires (not from the date of payment).
who_can_apply: Must be fishing in NSW waters (freshwater and saltwater).
Must be eligible for a recreational fishing fee exemption (if applicable).
what_you_need: Renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice)
MyServiceNSW Account (for adding a digital licence)
Service NSW app (for adding a digital licence)

how_to_steps.text: Enter your licence number and renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice)

fees:
For information on recreational fishing and licence fees visit NSW Primary Industries website.

You must show your licence fee receipt if asked by an authorised officer.

### Fee exemptions

Not everyone has to pay a fee for a recreational fishing licence.

Check if you are eligible for a recreational fishing fee exemption.

If you are eligible, you'll need to carry the necessary proof with you when you're fishing, in case you're called upon to show it.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to fish in NSW waters?
faqs.a: Yes, when fishing in NSW waters (both freshwater and saltwater), you are legally required to pay a recreational fishing fee and carry the receipt showing payment.

faqs.q: How do I renew my recreational fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your 1-year or 3-year recreational fishing licence online or by phone. To renew online, select the 'Renew online' button, enter your licence and renewal number, and complete the online form.

faqs.q: When does my new licence period start?
faqs.a: If you renew before your expiry date, your renewal period begins from the date your current licence expires, not from the date of payment.

faqs.q: What should I do if I am exempt from paying a fee?
faqs.a: If you are eligible for a fee exemption, you must carry the necessary proof with you when fishing, in case you are asked to show it by an authorised officer.
